subject: Sync never completes on desktop
body: The desktop client has been at 99 percent for two days. A handful of folders show the sync arrows permanently. I already quit and reopened the app.

subject: Stuck in a sign-in loop with SSO
body: Signing in with our corporate SSO puts me in a loop: Tidewater opens briefly and then I am back at the login page. Everyone in our office has this since this morning.

subject: Webhook deliveries have stopped
body: Our endpoint used to receive file event webhooks all day. Since Tuesday afternoon there has been nothing at all. Our server is running normally.

subject: Full export email never comes
body: I ask for the complete activity export, see the message that it will be emailed, and then nothing arrives. Our workspace is very large. Exports for a short date range do arrive.

subject: Push notifications gone after reinstalling on iPhone
body: I reinstalled the app on my iPhone and since then I get no push notifications when someone mentions me. Notifications are switched on in iOS settings.

subject: External invitees don't get the invite email
body: I invited several people from a partner organisation and resent the invites, but none of them got the email, spam folder included. Invitations inside our own company work.

subject: Still hitting too many requests after plan upgrade
body: We upgraded our plan for higher API limits, but our integration keeps failing with too many requests errors exactly as it did before the upgrade.

subject: Team calendar is an hour off for some people
body: Some people on my team see shared calendar meetings one hour early or late, others see them correctly. We checked the same event side by side.

subject: New uploads don't show up in search
body: Files uploaded this week cannot be found through search, even by exact name. Anything older shows up fine.

subject: Authenticator codes keep being refused
body: Login refuses the codes from my authenticator app as invalid. I tried many new codes one after another.
